rows.What You Will Pay.Out-of-Network Provide: Same as in-network pharmacy, plus you pay excess over our in-network drug cost
rows.Limitations, Exceptions, & Other Importa: Maximum day supply per fill is 30 days at retail, 90 days through mail order. Your cost share increases upon the third refill. See Brochure for more information about Maintenance Choice on how to save cost for maintenance medications. You pay in full at an Out-of-Network retail pharmacy and can submit for reimbursement. You pay all charges when you use an Out-of- Network Mail Order Provider. Brand name when generic available - same as generic drugs, plus the difference in cost of generic and brand name Services are provided through CVS Specialty Pharmacy.
